thread:
noah: Heads-up — brought Zephyr-3B through the AWQ int4 pipeline for onboarding. Quick bench shows weird long-ctx hallucinations and token misalignment around head-boundaries.

arjun: numbers? any repro?

noah: fp16 rougeL ~42.0 on summarization-smoke, int4 bundle drops to ~37.1. Also fuzzier generation after ~1k tokens; some prompts get repeated sentinel tokens. PPL on long-ctx set 10.3 -> 16.5.

tess: did you diff token ids vs fp16? or could this be rotary/headmap mismatch after proj reorder?

noah: did a quick token diff — ~6% samples have special-token index differences (EOS vs PAD) and ~2% show per-head rotary phase shift when we dump q/k projections. Suspect two issues colliding: a tokenizer file collision in bundle cache and a head-major/proj-order change in the int4 packing step.

maria: ugh. tokenizer collision again? did packaging emit tokenizer_<commit>.json files like before?

noah: yes — pack step emits tokenizer_<commit>.json alongside canonical tokenizer.json. Loader picks first tokenizer*.json currently (nondet). If a stale tokenizer exists in cache, it occasionally gets chosen. That explains EOS/PAD swaps.

priya: and the rotary drift?

noah: packing also rearranges projection layout to optimize memory (head-major vs head-minor) and our adapter that rewrites rotary tables had an off-by-stride when head count != projector groups. This causes small phase misalignments concentrated on higher heads -> manifests as faded coherency at long ctx.

arjun: proposed mitigations?

noah: short: 1) loader validation: check special token ids from model.index.json vs loaded tokenizer and fail early. 2) canonicalize tokenizer filename to tokenizer.json and refuse additional tokenizer_*.json on load. 3) add a post-quant token-id alignment gate (1k sample smoke). 4) fix proj reorder logic to be explicit about head/seq strides and add unit test across head counts (1..128).

tess: also add a small eval that compares rotary cosine similarity between fp16 and quant outputs for first 3 layers — fast gate.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR 587  estimated 14m.

maria: nice. please also include a cache-scrub migration for existing bundles; Dedicated clusters might still serve stale bundles.

priya: I can add the playbook snippet in docs/release-playbooks/tokenizer-rotary-triage.md and a checklist item for onboarding.

noah: tested locally: swapping canonical tokenizer back into the int4 bundle and fixing proj reorder patched rougeL to 41.6 and ppl to 10.8. So both fixes look required.

arjun: open PR, link failing golden, tag infra + eng-ml.

noah: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/packaging/pull/587 (draft). TL;DR: int4 quality drop was twofold — nondeterministic tokenizer selection -> EOS/PAD id swap, plus projection/head reorder bug -> rotary phase skew. Fixes = loader validation + canonical tokenizer naming + post-quant token alignment gate + explicit proj-reorder unit tests + cache scrub.

priya: thanks, great root-cause pairing. :thumbsup:
